functions.description: Extract syslog header fields (timestamp, host, process, pid) and remaining message body from infoblox port logs
Extract status code and optional peer IP address from the message body
Extract the network interface or port identifier referenced in the message
Extract any source IP address mentioned in the message text (e.g. remote peer or offending host)
Normalize severity based on status field and classify the port event action

add.name: severity
add.value: status === 'SUCCESS' ? 'info' : status === 'INFO' ? 'info' : status === 'WARNING' ? 'warning' : status === 'FAILURE' ? 'error' : status === 'ERROR' ? 'error' : status === 'FAILOVER' ? 'error' : status === 'CRITICAL' ? 'critical' : status === 'ALERT' ? 'critical' : 'unknown'

add.name: action
add.value: message && message.indexOf('link up') > -1 ? 'link_up' : message && message.indexOf('link down') > -1 ? 'link_down' : message && message.indexOf('failover') > -1 ? 'failover' : message && message.indexOf('login attempt') > -1 ? 'login_attempt' : message && message.indexOf('unauthorized') > -1 ? 'unauthorized_access' : message && message.indexOf('reset') > -1 ? 'reset' : 'status_change'
